title: Burning Crown Sovereign
description: A regal figure with closed eyes wears an ornate, tall crown engulfed in bright flames and radiating golden light. Their dark scaled armor glows with molten cracks as they raise one hand to their crown, set against a dark arched background with fiery embers.
prompt: A regal androgynous figure with closed eyes and dark skin marked by glowing embers, wearing an extremely tall ornate crown completely engulfed in bright flames and radiating intense golden light rays. They wear dark scaled armor with molten glowing cracks and orange lava flowing between plates. One hand is raised touching the crown. Dramatic low angle view, dark stone archway background with floating embers, rich dark fantasy atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
